; PROBE (temporary): will an ark Icon (what FoldoutItem uses for iconSource) render our
; own SVG from a file:// path?
;
; Findings so far:
;  - A plain QML Image loads the SVG fine via "file:///..." (READY 40x40); a bare
;    "/home/root/..." path fails. libqsvg.so is present on device.
;  - ArkImageDataProvider is undefined outside the ark module (Icon.qml only reaches it via
;    its implicit same-directory import), so the resolver can't be called from our contexts.
; So instantiate the real ArkControls.Icon here and log its resolved sourceSize: non-zero
; means the resolver accepted the URL and the menu icon will render. Compared against a
; stock icon source as a control.

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
	IMPORT ark.controls as ArkControls
	TRAVERSE ?#root
		LOCATE AFTER ALL
		INSERT {
			Item {
				id: iconProbe
				visible: false

				ArkControls.Icon {
					id: probeArkIcon
					source: "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/qt-resource-rebuilder/pinnedSleepScreen.svg"
					size: 40
					color: "#000000"
				}

				ArkControls.Icon {
					id: probeArkIconStock
					source: "qrc:/ark/icons/reading_light_off"
					size: 40
					color: "#000000"
				}

				Timer {
					id: iconProbeTimer
					interval: 1500
					running: true
					onTriggered: {
						console.log("ICONPROBE ours: visible=" + probeArkIcon.visible
							+ " sourceSize=" + probeArkIcon.sourceSize.width
							+ "x" + probeArkIcon.sourceSize.height
							+ " implicit=" + probeArkIcon.implicitWidth
							+ "x" + probeArkIcon.implicitHeight);
						console.log("ICONPROBE stock: visible=" + probeArkIconStock.visible
							+ " sourceSize=" + probeArkIconStock.sourceSize.width
							+ "x" + probeArkIconStock.sourceSize.height);
					}
				}
			}
		}
	END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
